title: Take its Essence, Discard its Dross! Debiasing for Toxic Language Detection via Counterfactual Causal Effect
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for debiasing toxic language detection models (using PLMs like BERT and RoBERTa) against lexical bias. While it mentions fairness and ethics in its methodology and impact statement, it does not include a component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, morals, or ethical systems.
